* Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
* Ensures compliance with all local, state and federal (e.g., OSHA, ASI and Health Department) regulations.
* Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
* Operates and maintains all department equipment and reports malfunctions.
* Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.

**Leading Kitchen Operations**

* Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
* Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
* Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
* Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
* Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
* Maintains the productivity level of associates.
* Ensures associates understand expectations and parameters.
* Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with associates and ensures associates do the same within the team.
* Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
* Recognizes success performance and produces desired results.

**Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service**

* Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
* Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
* Sets a positive example for guest relations.
* Empowers associates to provide excellent customer service.
* Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
* Handles guest problems and complaints.

**Maintaining Culinary Goals**

* Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
* Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
* Utilizes the Labor Management System to effectively schedule to business demands and for tracking of associate time and attendance.
* Trains associates in safety procedures.

**Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities**

* Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
* Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, AZ, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
### **General Information**

Country/Region

United Arab Emirates

Province/City

Abu Dhabi

Hiring Entity

Rosewood Abu Dhabi

Department

Food & Beverage - Culinary

Job Type

Internship

### **Job Description**

### **OUR PURPOSE AND CULTURE**

We are driven to create a future where people and place enrich one another. We are wholly committed to rooting ourselves more deeply in every place we are in while setting new benchmarks for positive impact.

As a pioneering collective with a common purpose, we curate extraordinary moments and honor the soul of every place along our journey. At Rosewood Hotel Group, we answer The Calling. Together, we Make the Place.

  
  

**THE TEAM**
------------

The Culinary team at Rosewood Abu Dhabi is passionate about creating exceptional dining experiences through creativity, craftsmanship, and attention to detail. Working across a variety of restaurants, lounges, banqueting operations, and culinary concepts, the team is committed to delivering the highest standards of quality, consistency, and innovation.

As a Culinary Intern, you will report to the Sous Chef and gain hands-on experience alongside experienced culinary professionals while learning the foundations of luxury hospitality and culinary excellence.

  
  

**YOUR ROLE**
-------------

As a Culinary Intern, you will support the culinary team in the preparation, presentation, and service of food across assigned kitchen areas. This internship provides a valuable opportunity to develop technical culinary skills while gaining practical exposure to professional kitchen operations within a luxury hotel environment.

You will learn and contribute to daily kitchen activities while maintaining the highest standards of food safety, hygiene, quality, and teamwork.

  
  

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE THE PLACE**
-----------------------------

* Support chefs in preparing ingredients, mise en place, and food items for daily operations and service periods
* Learn and apply culinary techniques, recipes, presentation standards, and kitchen procedures under the guidance of experienced chefs
* Maintain cleanliness, organization, and hygiene standards throughout kitchen work areas and equipment
* Assist with food storage, stock rotation, and product handling in accordance with food safety requirements and FIFO procedures
* Contribute to a safe and collaborative working environment by following operational and safety standards
* Participate actively in training sessions, culinary development opportunities, and departmental projects
  

  

**COULD THIS BE YOU?**
----------------------

* You are passionate about culinary arts and eager to build a career in hospitality
* You are currently studying or have recently completed education related to Culinary Arts, Hospitality, or a related field
* You demonstrate a positive attitude, willingness to learn, and strong work ethic
* You have excellent attention to detail and take pride in delivering high-quality work
* You enjoy working as part of a diverse and collaborative team
* You communicate effectively in English; additional language skills are an advantage
* Previous kitchen experience is beneficial but not essential
  

  

**OUR BENEFITS**
----------------

As part of our team, you'll enjoy a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your wellbeing, professional growth, and life beyond work. This includes learning and development opportunities, hands-on exposure to luxury hospitality operations, mentorship from industry professionals, and opportunities to build a strong foundation for a successful hospitality career.

  
  

**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU**
-------------------------

At Rosewood Hotel Group, your voice is heard and valued. We're a community that encourages associates to be themselves, not fit into a fixed culture, and this philosophy shines through in our commitment to reflect and honor the history, culture, and geography of our destinations.

We are committed to building meaningful relationships, celebrating diversity, and fostering an environment where everyone can thrive through our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) strategy.

### **About Us**

Located on Al Maryah Island at the core of Abu Dhabi’s new Central Business District (CBD), Rosewood Abu Dhabi is a five-star luxury hotel inspired by the glistening Arabian Gulf, reflecting the history, architecture, and culture of Abu Dhabi. You will discover spacious guest rooms, fine dining, and world-class amenities married to stunning views.

As a pioneering collective with a common purpose, we curate extraordinary moments and honor the soul of every place along our journey. At Rosewood Hotel Group, we answer The Calling. Together, we Make the Place.

  
  

**THE TEAM**
------------

The Food & Beverage team at Rosewood Abu Dhabi is dedicated to creating memorable guest experiences through exceptional service, genuine hospitality, and outstanding product quality. Our café and lounge operations are designed to bring people together through meaningful interactions, premium beverages, and personalized service.

As a Junior Barista, you will report to the Outlet Manager and work closely with the Food & Beverage team to deliver exceptional beverage experiences while supporting the smooth operation of the outlet.

  
  

**YOUR ROLE**
-------------

As a Junior Barista, you will be responsible for preparing and serving high-quality coffee, tea, and specialty beverages while delivering warm, personalized, and attentive service to every guest.

You will play an important role in creating memorable moments through expert beverage preparation, product knowledge, and genuine guest engagement. Through your passion for hospitality and attention to detail, you will contribute to the success of the outlet while upholding Rosewood's standards of excellence.

  
  

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE THE PLACE**
-----------------------------

* Prepare and serve coffee, tea, and specialty beverages according to established recipes, presentation standards, and Rosewood service expectations
* Deliver exceptional guest experiences by providing personalized service, menu recommendations, and product knowledge
* Maintain beverage quality, consistency, and presentation standards while ensuring efficient service delivery
* Support outlet operations through effective mise en place preparation, inventory management, and stock replenishment
* Maintain cleanliness, hygiene, and organization of all equipment, workstations, and service areas
* Follow POS, cash handling, and payment procedures accurately while supporting operational efficiency
* Build meaningful relationships with guests and colleagues by embracing Rosewood's philosophy of Relationship Hospitality
* Participate in training and development initiatives while continuously expanding beverage knowledge and service skills
  

  

**COULD THIS BE YOU?**
----------------------

* You have experience in coffee preparation, café operations, Food & Beverage service, or hospitality environments
* You are passionate about coffee, tea, specialty beverages, and creating memorable guest experiences
* You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a warm and engaging personality
* You have strong attention to detail and take pride in maintaining exceptional product quality and presentation
* You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and professionalism
* You are familiar with POS systems, cash handling procedures, and hospitality operations
* You communicate fluently in English; additional language skills are highly valued
  

  

**OUR BENEFITS**
----------------

As part of our team, you'll enjoy a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your wellbeing, professional growth, and life beyond work. This includes medical coverage, paid time off, complimentary room nights, learning and development opportunities, global career opportunities, and industry-leading paid parental leave supporting eligible associates across all paths to parenthood.

  
  

**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU**
-------------------------

At Rosewood Hotel Group, your voice is heard and valued. We're a community that encourages associates to be themselves, not fit into a fixed culture, and this philosophy shines through in our commitment to reflect and honor the history, culture, and geography of our destinations.

We are committed to building meaningful relationships, celebrating diversity, and fostering an environment where everyone can thrive through our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) strategy.

### **About Us**

Located on Al Maryah Island at the core of Abu Dhabi’s new Central Business District (CBD), Rosewood Abu Dhabi is a five-star luxury hotel inspired by the glistening Arabian Gulf, reflecting the history, architecture, and culture of Abu Dhabi. You will discover spacious guest rooms, fine dining, and world-class amenities married to stunning views.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Manager to lead sales operations for our Non-Food Division, covering Luggage, Cookware, Stationery, Cleaning Equipment, and Cosmetics & Personal Care categories. The ideal candidate will bring a minimum of 10 years of progressive sales experience, with a strong track record of business development and in-depth knowledge of the UAE market.

The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving profitable sales growth across all assigned categories, expanding the customer base through new business development, managing Business Development Agreements (BDAs) with customers, and strengthening relationships with existing key accounts. This role also carries direct accountability for customer profitability, ensuring each account contributes sustainably to overall business margins. The successful candidate will lead and mentor a sales team of 25, requiring a strategic, hands-on leader capable of identifying market opportunities, building long-term customer partnerships, and delivering sustainable revenue growth in a competitive multi-category environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute sales strategies for the Non-Food Division across Luggage, Cookware, Stationery, Cleaning Equipment, and Cosmetics & Personal Care categories
* Identify, target, and onboard new customers to expand market reach and revenue streams
* Manage, retain, and grow key accounts through strong relationship management and tailored business solutions
* Negotiate, implement, and manage Business Development Agreements (BDAs) with customers, ensuring terms deliver mutual value and align with company profitability targets
* Monitor and track BDA performance, ensuring compliance with agreed terms, trade spend, and ROI objectives
* Own customer profitability across all accounts, monitoring margins, cost-to-serve, and trade investment to ensure sustainable and profitable partnerships
* Drive profitable sales growth by optimizing pricing, product mix, and customer engagement strategies
* Monitor UAE market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs to identify new business opportunities
* Prepare and present sales forecasts, budgets, and performance reports to senior management
* Collaborate with internal teams (marketing, supply chain, finance) to ensure smooth order fulfillment and customer satisfaction
* Lead, mentor, and motivate a sales team of 25 to achieve individual and departmental targets

**Requirements**

* Minimum 10 years of sales experience, preferably within FMCG, retail, or distribution sectors
* Proven experience managing multi-category product portfolios
* Strong knowledge of the UAE market and established customer/trade relationships
* Demonstrated success in new business development, key account management, and BDA negotiation/administration
* Strong understanding of profitability drivers and experience managing customer P&L or margin accountability
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and leadership skills
* Proven people leadership experience, ideally managing mid-to-large sales teams
* Ability to work independently and deliver results in a target-driven environment

Application Question(s):

* Which product categories have you managed previously? Have you worked with any of the following: Luggage, Cookware, Stationery, Cleaning Equipment, or Cosmetics & Personal Care?
* Which channels have you sold through (e.g., modern trade, traditional trade/wholesale, e-commerce, HORECA)?
* How large a sales team have you managed or led?
* How many years of sales experience do you have, and how many of those are within the UAE market?
* What is you notice period?
* What is your visa status?
* What is your current salary?

jobs.description:
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented **Sales & Training Executive** with **2–5 years of experience in the F&B industry** to manage sales activities, customer relationships, coffee-related training, and day-to-day operational coordination in Gurgaon.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication and relationship-management skills, a good understanding of the F&B market, and the ability to coordinate effectively between customers, sales, vendors, and internal operations teams.

**Experience or strong exposure to the specialty coffee beans business and café operations will be highly preferred.** The candidate should have a basic understanding of **specialty coffee, coffee beans, brewing methods, café operations, barista practices, and customer handling.**

The candidate should also have **basic practical knowledge of barista training and latte art.** The company will provide additional product, technical, and training support; however, candidates are expected to have a **fundamental understanding of barista skills, coffee preparation, latte art, and specialty coffee concepts** before joining.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales & Business Development**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities within the F&B market.
* Handle sales activities for specialty coffee beans, café products, and related offerings.
* Develop and maintain relationships with B2B and B2C customers.
* Coordinate with cafés, restaurants, hotels, distributors, and corporate customers.
* Generate leads through market visits, references, networking, and other channels.
* Prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and follow up with clients for order closure.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to overall business growth.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with clients regarding enquiries, orders, deliveries, and payments.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable coffee products and solutions.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements.

**Barista Training & Coffee Knowledge**

* Should be able to conduct **barista training** for café staff and customers.
* Demonstrate coffee preparation, espresso-making, milk steaming, and beverage preparation techniques.
* Provide **latte art lessons**, including milk texturing and fundamental latte art techniques.
* Explain concepts of **specialty coffee**, including coffee beans, roast profiles, flavour characteristics, freshness, grinding, brewing, and extraction.
* Demonstrate proper handling, storage, grinding, and preparation of specialty coffee beans.
* Support customers and café teams in understanding the correct use and application of coffee products.
* Conduct product demonstrations and coffee training sessions at customer locations when required.
* Assist the management in developing training materials, demonstrations, and product knowledge sessions.
* Continue developing knowledge of specialty coffee, brewing techniques, café trends, and new coffee products.

**Operations**

* Coordinate with customers, vendors, logistics, and internal teams to ensure smooth order execution.
* Monitor order processing, delivery schedules, and customer requirements.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and operational issues.
* Coordinate with accounts for billing, outstanding payments, and related documentation.
* Maintain proper records of sales, orders, customer interactions, training sessions, and operational activities.
* Track daily activities and provide regular reports to management.
* Ensure smooth coordination between sales, training, and operations functions.

**Required Coffee Knowledge & Skills**

The candidate **must have basic knowledge or prior exposure to:**

* **Barista skills and café operations**
* **Espresso preparation and basic coffee brewing**
* **Milk steaming and texturing**
* **Advanced latte art**
* **Specialty coffee concepts and terminology**
* **Coffee beans, roast profiles, grinding, and extraction**
* Understanding of coffee equipment and café workflow
* Customer-facing coffee product demonstrations

**Advanced barista or specialty coffee certification is not mandatory.** However, the candidate must have genuine interest and basic practical knowledge of coffee and should be comfortable learning and conducting further training. **The company will provide additional training to enhance the candidate's technical and product knowledge.**

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **2–5 years of relevant experience in Sales, F&B, Café Operations, Business Development, or Training.**
* **F&B industry experience is mandatory.**
* Experience or exposure to **specialty coffee beans business and café operations** is highly preferred.
* Knowledge of **barista training and latte art is mandatory.**
* Strong understanding or interest in **specialty coffee** is required.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong negotiation and client-handling abilities.
* Good coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to conduct product demonstrations and basic training sessions.
* Ability to travel for customer meetings, café visits, and training sessions.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel, Google Sheets, email, and reporting**.
* Strong follow-up skills with a result-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with different teams.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is **energetic, proactive, commercially aware, and hands-on**, with the ability to manage **sales, customer relationships, coffee training, and operational execution**.

Candidates from **specialty coffee companies, cafés, restaurants, catering, food service, cloud kitchens, hospitality, coffee equipment companies, food distribution, FMCG/F&B sales, or related F&B businesses** will be preferred.

**Candidates with basic barista knowledge, latte art skills, and an understanding of specialty coffee who are willing to develop their technical expertise through company-provided training are encouraged to apply.**

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Europe
jobs.description:
**NULO IS:**

We are the fastest-growing U.S. pet food specialty brand and have recently begun our European expansion with major retail listings across Italy, Spain and the UK. We were named “Top 25 Most Innovative Consumer Brands” by Forbes Magazine, offering industry-leading dog and cat food products with a world-class sales team, in a multi-billion-dollar industry that’s ripe for innovation and change. Imagine inspiring pet parents to think differently about the experience of feeding their dogs and cats, to feed them like the little athletes they are - with foods high in meat protein, low in carbs and infused with viable probiotics. To learn more visit www.nulo.co.uk

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

After entering the market in late 2025, Nulo is entering an exciting phase of European growth - building our presence across existing markets while preparing to expand into a number of major new markets from 2027 onwards.

As Brand Manager Europe, you will play a central role in building Nulo into a distinctive, relevant and commercially successful brand across Europe, with primary responsibility for the UK, Spain and other key markets. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, local Marketing Managers, as well as wider European and global brand/commercial teams, you will translate Nulo’s global brand strategy into key European growth markets, driving the short and long-term success of the brand in Europe.

This is a hands-on brand management role with ownership across annual brand planning, marketing campaigns, consumer insight, brand health, proposition development and commercial performance. You will be the guardian of Nulo’s brand positioning and distinctive assets, developing and delivering the brand strategies and activation plans needed to drive sustainable growth in each market.

Fluent English and Spanish are essential with additional European languages useful. Frequent European travel is expected.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* **Own the Annual Brand Marketing Plan –** working closely with the European Head of Marketing, create and deliver the annual marketing plan in key priority markets, aligned to commercial priorities and long-term brand strategy
* **Lead Consumer Communications –** adapt and deliver compelling, locally relevant communications across paid, owned and earned channels
* **Build & Optimise the Nulo Demand Generation Engine –** working with the wider marketing team, develop and own a full-funnel demand generation programme that drives brand awareness, consideration and trial to recruit consumers at scale
* **Develop Consumer & Category Insight** - build a deep understanding of consumers, category dynamics, competitors and emerging trends, converting insight into clear actions for the brand and portfolio.
* **Drive Brand Health & Performance** - track brand, category and commercial performance across priority markets, identifying growth opportunities and actions to improve awareness, consideration and trial, driving brand penetration and equity.
* **Shape Local Brand Positioning** - act as a guardian of Nulo’s positioning, distinctive assets and brand codes, ensuring global consistency is combined with local relevance
* **Portfolio Strategy & Innovation** - Lead on product lifecycle including performance analysis, opportunity identification, working with global teams on innovation and renovation
* **Lead Integrated Brand Campaign Development** - work with local & global teams and agency partners to develop and execute local campaigns.
* **360 Customer Planning** – lead development and execution of joint customer marketing plans.
* **Support Pricing & Portfolio Architecture** - partner with Commercial and Finance to inform pricing, pack architecture, promotional strategy and portfolio choices that support brand equity and profitable growth.
* **Brand P&L management** - manage and report on full brand P&L including managing brand investment, setting priorities and evaluating activity effectiveness
* **Agency & Partner Management** - lead relevant agency and specialist partner relationships, setting clear briefs and ensuring high-quality, on-brand delivery against timings and budgets.
* **Cross-functional Brand Leadership** - act as a key connector across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory and Global Teams to align priorities and deliver key initiatives

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* 5+ years of brand management or marketing experience in FMCG, food, pet, or a related consumer-goods sector.
* Strong experience developing annual brand plans and translating consumer and commercial insight into clear growth strategies.
* Strong analytical capability with experience using consumer, category and commercial data to identify opportunities and measure performance.
* Commercial mindset with an understanding of pricing, promotional strategy, portfolio architecture and brand P&L drivers.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns and working across the full funnel
* Demonstrable experience working with key customers including joint business planning and shopper activations.
* Strong agency and cross-functional stakeholder management experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to turn strategy into clear direction for others.
* Budget management experience and a strong focus on investment effectiveness.
* Fluent English and Spanish.

**Desirable Experience & Skills**

* Experience working across multiple European markets.
* Experience managing a portfolio, including innovation / NPD, renovation, proposition development and product launches.
* Experience within pet food, pet care, food, beverage or another premium FMCG category.
* Additional European languages are a plus.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* **Brand Builder** - you care deeply about what makes brands distinctive and know how to build equity consistently over time.
* **Consumer Obsessed** - you are curious about people, culture and behaviour and use insight to inform brand strategy.
* **Commercially minded** – you are comfortable converting business objectives into marketing objectives and strategies
* **Analytical** - you are comfortable with data and use it to diagnose performance, challenge assumptions and make clear recommendations.
* **Hands-on** - you are equally comfortable shaping strategy, reviewing packaging, building a business case, briefing an agency and preparing a customer story.
* **Entrepreneurial** - you are a self-starter who thrives in a growing organisation where not every process or answer already exists.
* **Collaborative** - you build strong relationships across functions, markets and external partners
* **Fast & Pragmatic** - you maintain high standards without sacrificing pace of execution in the pursuit of perfection.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL GET:**

* Competitive salary and benefits, in line with the local market and experience.
* Full-time, permanent contract.
* Travel costs covered in line with company policy.

**Location**

This is a full-time, mostly remote position, with frequent European travel. We need this person to be willing to travel frequently around Europe.

**Salary Range:** €45K - €55K

Drive continuous improvement opportunities in product quality, process control, and food safety.

Support SAP release of finished goods.

**Job Title:** Retail Sales Lead

**Industry** - FMCG / Snacking / Food & Beverages / Confectionery

**Role Overview**

The Retail Sales Lead will own the UAE retail business across distributors and retailer accounts. The role combines sales, distribution, trade marketing, merchandising, account management, commercial planning, and P&L ownership. The candidate will work closely with distributors and key retail partners to build joint business plans, drive sell-in and sell-out, improve distribution and visibility, and ensure strong execution across stores and channels.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Retail Sales & Key Account Management**

 Own sales and business development across assigned UAE retail accounts, including modern trade, supermarkets, hypermarkets, convenience, specialty retail and other relevant channels.

 Build and maintain strong commercial relationships with retailer buying, category, trade marketing and merchandising teams.

 Lead commercial negotiations covering listings, pricing, promotions, visibility, trade terms, displays, launches and annual business plans.

 Develop account-level sales plans and deliver monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.

 Track sell-in, sell-out, stock levels, distribution, rate of sale and promotional performance by account.

**2. Distributor Management & Distribution**

 Manage company's UAE distributor relationships and act as the primary commercial interface between the company, distributor and retail accounts.

 Set distributor targets, channel plans, assortment priorities, inventory norms and execution KPIs.

 Build Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with distributors covering revenue, distribution, new listings, promotions, inventory, working capital and marketing investments.

 Review distributor performance regularly and drive corrective actions where required.

 Ensure effective order planning, stock availability, replenishment and distribution across priority retail outlets.

 Monitor distributor inventory, ageing, returns, expiries and receivables to protect business economics.

**3. P&L & Commercial Ownership**

 Own and manage account/channel-level commercial P&Ls and understand revenue, gross margin, trade spends, discounts, promotional investments and contribution economics.

 Track actuals versus budget and identify opportunities to improve revenue quality and profitability.

 Evaluate promotional ROI, retailer investments, listing fees, visibility spends and distributor margins.

 Work with finance and management on forecasts, budgets, sales plans and commercial decisions.

**4. Trade Marketing & Joint Business Planning**

 Develop retailer-specific and distributor-specific annual and quarterly Joint Business Plans.

 Plan and execute trade marketing calendars across promotions, launches, sampling, activations, displays and in-store visibility.

 Coordinate with marketing teams to translate brand campaigns into effective retail execution.

 Identify category growth opportunities and recommend relevant activations, offers and visibility initiatives.

 Measure the commercial impact of trade marketing investments and continuously improve ROI.

**5. Merchandising & In-Store Execution**

 Own in-store visibility and merchandising standards across key retail accounts.

 Ensure correct shelf placement, planogram compliance, secondary displays, POSM deployment, pricing visibility and promotional execution.

 Conduct regular market/store visits and identify gaps in availability, visibility, pricing and execution.

 Work with distributors and merchandising teams to close execution gaps quickly.

 Build a strong understanding of the UAE retail landscape, including store formats, shopper behaviour and category dynamics.

**6. New Business Development**

 Identify and open new retail, convenience, specialty and institutional opportunities relevant to company.

 Develop retailer pitches, commercial proposals and launch plans for new accounts.

 Build a pipeline of prospective retail partners and manage the full process from prospecting to listing and execution.

 Support expansion into new channels and emirates as the business scales.

**7. Reporting & Business Reviews**

 Prepare weekly and monthly sales and distribution reports covering revenue, sell-out, inventory, distribution, promotions and key account performance.

 Lead periodic business reviews with distributors and retailer partners.

 Provide management with clear market intelligence, competitor activity, pricing observations and account-level opportunities.

 Use data to identify gaps and convert insights into specific commercial actions.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

 4–7 years of relevant experience in UAE sales, retail sales, distribution, key account management or trade marketing.

 Mandatory on-ground UAE experience with established relationships and practical knowledge of the UAE retail ecosystem.

 Experience in FMCG, snacking, confectionery, food & beverages, nutrition, consumer products or a closely related category.

 Experience working directly with UAE distributors and major retail accounts.

 Demonstrated experience in negotiating retailer terms, promotions, listings, merchandising and joint business plans.

 Strong commercial understanding of P&L, margins, trade spends, distributor economics and promotional ROI.

 Strong analytical, negotiation and relationship-management skills.

 Excellent communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.

 Willingness to travel extensively across the UAE and spend significant time in-market and in stores.

 UAE driving licence is preferred.

**The Role**

The Restaurant General Manager is accountable for the commercial and operational success of ULA, driving revenue growth, profitability, guest satisfaction and consistent service excellence.

The role is to position ULA as a leading beachfront dining and lifestyle destination, attract both in-house and external guests, build loyalty and develop experiences that keep the venue competitive.

Working closely with Marketing, Culinary and Food & Beverage teams, the Restaurant General Manager will drive business development, events and promotions, optimize performance and lead a motivated, high-performing team.

**1. Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Achieve revenue and profit targets by growing covers, average guest spend, beverage sales and repeat business.
* Strengthen ULA’s reputation as a leading dining and beachfront lifestyle destination in Ras Al Khaimah and the wider UAE market.
* Develop commercial action plans with Marketing, including targeted promotions, brunches, events and seasonal activations, with measurable results.
* Proactively generate external business through relationships with UAE residents, corporate clients, event organizers and relevant partners.
* Grow guest loyalty through personalized service, guest recognition and relationship management.
* Monitor competitors, trends, demand patterns and guest preferences; develop strategies for weekdays and off-peak periods.
* Partner with Culinary and Beverage teams on menu engineering, seasonal offerings, new concepts and profitable dining experiences.
* Monitor reservations, conversion, table utilization and campaign or event performance to identify revenue opportunities.

**2. Restaurant Operations & Service Quality**

* Oversee ULA’s daily restaurant, bar and assigned beach/poolside guest operations, ensuring efficient and coordinated service.
* Maintain high standards of food and beverage quality, presentation, service, cleanliness and the overall guest experience.
* Maintain a strong presence on the floor, actively engaging with guests and supporting the team.
* Ensure consistent service standards, operating procedures and brand requirements across all assigned guest areas.
* Handle guest complaints professionally and ensure effective service recovery.
* Monitor guest feedback, online reviews and satisfaction scores, implementing corrective actions when necessary.
* Coordinate with Kitchen, Bar, Entertainment and supporting teams to deliver seamless events and peak-period operations.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, responsible alcohol service, health and safety, and applicable venue requirements; coordinate pool/beach safety with designated teams.
* Maintain venue ambience, music, guest flow, facilities and equipment to create an attractive, safe and welcoming environment.

\*

**3. Team Leadership, Training & Development**

* Lead, motivate and inspire the restaurant team to deliver exceptional service and achieve business objectives.
* Create a positive working environment based on teamwork, respect, accountability and employee engagement.
* Ensure effective manpower planning, duty scheduling and productivity management.
* Identify training needs and organize regular training sessions covering service standards, product knowledge, upselling and guest engagement.
* Coach and develop team members through continuous feedback, performance reviews and on-the-job training.
* Identify high-potential employees and support their career development and internal promotion.
* Participate in recruitment, selection and onboarding in collaboration with People & Culture.
* Conduct regular team briefings to communicate business performance, guest feedback and operational priorities.
* Address performance issues promptly and fairly, maintaining professional standards and discipline.
* Lead by example, demonstrating professionalism, integrity and Accor values.

**4. Financial Management & Cost Control**

* Take ownership of outlet revenue, controllable profitability and achievement of approved budgets and targets.
* Prepare and review budgets, forecasts and daily, weekly and monthly performance reports with the Director of Food & Beverage.
* Monitor payroll, labour productivity, food and beverage costs, operating expenses and profit margins.

* Ensure compliance with cash handling, billing, discount and complimentary procedures.

**5. Administration & Coordination**

* Maintain accurate operational records, reports, attendance and payroll documentation.
* Coordinate leave plans and staffing requirements in line with business demand.
* Attend Food & Beverage departmental meetings and contribute to business planning.
* Coordinate with Marketing, Culinary, Finance, Engineering, Security and other departments to support venue objectives.
* Ensure required operational documentation, licences, event approvals and safety procedures are maintained.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Performance will be evaluated against agreed objectives, including:

* **Revenue & Profitability:** Revenue versus budget, growth, average spend, beverage sales, staff and F&B costs, and controllable profit.
* **Business Development:** External guest covers, repeat business, reservations, event and promotion results, and new partnerships.
* **Guest Experience & Quality:** Guest satisfaction, online reputation, service recovery and service standards.
* **People & Culture:** Employee engagement, retention, training, development and team productivity.
* **Operational Excellence:** Service consistency, seat utilization, hygiene, safety and brand compliance.

jobs.description:

Sapaad is a global leader in unified commerce platforms, delivering world-class software solutions for the food and beverage industry. Our flagship product, also named Sapaad, has achieved remarkable success over the past decade—empowering thousands of F&B businesses across 40+ countries, with many more coming onboard each day.

Driven by a passionate team of developers, designers, and product experts, Sapaad is constantly evolving—introducing innovative, industry-defining features that set the benchmark for F&B technology. Headquartered in Singapore, with offices across five countries, Sapaad is backed by seasoned technology veterans with deep expertise in web, mobility, and e-commerce.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a driven, field-based Field Sales Executive to join our Sales team in the UAE. This is a hands-on sales role focused on introducing Sapaad’s technology solutions to businesses across the food and beverage industry.

This is a true door-to-door sales role. You will proactively visit businesses, meet owners and managers face-to-face, present the value of Sapaad’s solutions, and convert prospects into customers. You will be responsible for building and managing your own sales pipeline, driving conversions, and consistently delivering against your sales targets.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Hit the field daily:** Visit SME businesses and F&B establishments in your assigned areas, proactively approaching owners, managers, and decision-makers to introduce Sapaad’s technology solutions.

**Build your own pipeline:** Identify prospects independently through area mapping, cold visits, referrals, and other field prospecting activities. Follow up consistently and convert interest into new customers.

**Pitch and demonstrate:** Conduct face-to-face presentations and product demonstrations, highlighting how Sapaad’s solutions can streamline business operations, improve efficiency, and address customers’ business needs.

**Close the deal:** Handle questions and objections, negotiate where needed, present relevant commercial terms, and convert prospects into paying customers.

**Achieve targets:** Work towards individual targets for new customer acquisition and revenue generation, contributing to Sapaad’s growth in the UAE.

**Keep accurate records:** Log visits, leads, customer interactions, follow-ups, and pipeline status in the CRM or designated tools.

**Hand over smoothly:** Work with the onboarding and support teams to ensure newly acquired customers are successfully onboarded and their solutions are implemented smoothly.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

**Field sales experience (preferred):** 1 to 3 years in field sales, business development, or a customer-facing role. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills and real drive are welcome.

**Confidence in cold approaches:** Comfortable walking into a business unannounced and starting a conversation with the owner.

**Persistence:** A self-motivated, target-driven mindset with the discipline to follow up until the deal closes.

**Clear communication:** The ability to explain a technology product simply to non-technical business owners.

**Objection handling:** The ability to understand a customer’s needs and adjust your pitch for each type of business.

**Self-management:** Good organisation to plan your own daily routes, visits, and follow-ups.

**Field readiness:** Comfortable travelling across the UAE and spending most of the day out of the office.

**Languages:** Fluent English. Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, or other regional languages are an advantage.

**Location:** Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan

**Job Type:** Full-time

**About the Company**

Northern Extracts is a manufacturer of oleoresins, essential oils, and herbal extracts, specializing in North Indian herbs and spices. We serve the seasonings, flavors, fragrance, and nutraceutical industries across domestic and international markets.

Our Corporate Office is in Jaipur, with a manufacturing facility in Roopangarh, near Ajmer. The company is committed to quality, food safety, and regulatory compliance, with applications for FSSC 22000, ISO, Kosher, Halal, and FSSAI certifications.

**Role Overview**

To ensure timely procurement, optimum inventory availability, supplier performance, material traceability, and cost-effective purchasing in coordination with Production, Planning, QA/QC, R&D, Stores, Finance, and other functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Purchase & Procurement:** Procure raw materials, essential oil ingredients, botanical materials, packaging, chemicals, and consumables; obtain quotations; negotiate commercial terms; prepare POs; follow up deliveries; and maintain approved suppliers.
* **Inventory Management:** Maintain optimum stock, minimum/maximum and safety levels; monitor slow/non-moving and excess stock; conduct physical verification; reconcile ERP records; and ensure FIFO/FEFO and batch-wise control.
* **Material Planning:** Coordinate with Production, Planning, QA/QC, R&D, and Stores; review production plans; prepare MRP; ensure critical material availability; and identify shortages in advance.
* **Food-Grade / Essential Oil Control:** Procure against approved specifications; coordinate COA, food-grade, allergen, MSDS/SDS and origin documentation; support incoming inspection; maintain batch/lot traceability and suitable storage conditions.
* **Vendor Management:** Develop alternate suppliers; negotiate annual/long-term rates where practical; monitor TAT (Turn Around Time), rejection, lead time and competitiveness; resolve supplier issues; and conduct vendor performance reviews.
* **Stores & Warehouse Coordination:** Coordinate inward receipt, GRN (Goods Receiving Note), inspection and issue; maintain identification, labeling and location control; support segregation of approved/rejected/under-inspection/expired materials; and coordinate returns/transfers.
* **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) & Documentation:** Maintain Purchase request, RFQ (Requisition Form), quotation comparison, PO (Purchase Order), GRN (Goods Receiving Note), stock and supplier records; ensure authority-matrix compliance; support audit documentation; and coordinate PO/GRN/invoice matching with Finance.
* **Cost Control:** Identify purchase savings and optimization opportunities; compare historical/market prices; control emergency purchases and excess inventory; and negotiate improved commercial terms without compromising quality or supply continuity.

**Key Competencies**

* Procurement & negotiation
* Inventory planning & stock control
* Vendor management
* MRP / material planning

* Food-grade documentation & traceability

jobs.description:
About Company

House of Spices is a leading South Asian Food manufacturer and distributor in North America (USA & Canada) and has been delivering pure and quality products for over 50 years with 11 distribution centers throughout North America. We have our own brands and have exclusivity for distributing our partner brands in US / Canada. Our vision is to bring our culture alive through the celebration of authentic ethnic food, flavor and families. Our mission is to provide consumers easy access to all authentic ethnic food and flavors across the North American marketplace with a will to win. Visit www.hosindia.com to know more.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Summary/Objective:

The Supplier QA Executive will be primarily responsible for on-site production witnessing and supplier quality assurance for HOS products manufactured at supplier/co-packer facilities across South India.

The key responsibility is to ensure that every witnessed production is carried out as per approved HOS product specifications, formulations, process parameters, food-safety requirements, SOPs, GMP/GHP, sanitation requirements and applicable US FDA/FSMA requirements.

The position will have a strong shop-floor presence and will be responsible for identifying deviations during production, immediately communicating risks, ensuring containment, supporting root-cause analysis (RCA) and verifying effective implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

This is primarily a field-based supplier QA role, not a documentation-focused position.

**Base Location: Vadodara**

Key Responsibilities

**Supplier Production Witnessing & Process Compliance**

* Regularly visit assigned suppliers and witness production to ensure products are manufactured as per approved HOS specifications, formulations, process parameters, SOPs, quality standards and applicable food-safety requirements. Verify actual production conditions and process controls rather than relying only on supplier documentation.

**Raw Material, Formulation & Product Specification Compliance**

* Verify the use of approved raw materials, ingredients and packaging materials and ensure formulation, processing, product characteristics, net weight and finished-product requirements comply with approved HOS specifications. Identify and escalate any unauthorized changes or deviations.

**Critical Process & Food Safety Control Verification**

* Verify implementation and monitoring of HACCP/Preventive Controls, CCPs, critical process parameters and other food-safety controls during production, with particular focus on
  **Frozen RTE and Rice processing**
  .

**Ready to eat products Quality Assurance:**

* Provide strong on-site quality oversight for Frozen RTE and Rice products, including cooking, cooling, freezing, hygiene, cross-contamination controls, temperature controls, foreign-material controls, destoning, grading, sortex, admixture, varietal authenticity and other product-specific requirements.

**GMP, Hygiene, Sanitation & Plant Verification**

* Conduct regular physical verification of supplier facilities for GMP/GHP, personnel hygiene, housekeeping, cleaning and sanitation, pest control, allergen control, foreign-material prevention, equipment condition, calibration and other prerequisite programs.

**Supplier Quality & Food Safety Audits**

* Conduct and support supplier/co-packer assessments and audits against HOS requirements, approved specifications, applicable regulatory requirements, GMP, HACCP/Preventive Controls, FSSC 22000/ISO 22000, BRC/customer requirements and other applicable standards.

**Deviation, Non-Conformance & Containment Management**

* Identify quality and food-safety deviations during production, ensure appropriate immediate containment and segregation of affected material, determine the scope of impact and communicate significant issues to the QA Manager before product release or shipment.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

* Lead or support supplier investigations for production deviations, complaints and non-conformances and ensure effective RCA using appropriate tools such as
  **5 Why, Fishbone and process analysis**
  . Challenge incomplete or unsupported root causes and ensure the RCA addresses the actual cause of failure.

**CAPA Implementation & Effectiveness Verification**

* Review supplier CAPA, verify implementation at the supplier site and ensure corrective and preventive actions address the identified root cause. CAPA shall be closed only after objective evidence and, where required, follow-up production witnessing demonstrate effectiveness and prevention of recurrence.

**Complaint, Traceability & Supplier Performance Management**

* Support investigation of customer and internal complaints, verify batch/lot traceability, mock recalls, sample retention and relevant supplier records, and monitor supplier performance to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities

**Reporting, Follow-Up & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare timely supplier visit and production-witnessing reports, document observations and objective evidence, track open actions and CAPA, follow up with suppliers until effective closure, and identify opportunities to improve supplier processes, quality performance and food-safety controls.

Travel

1. Travel is mandatory for this Job Profile

Required Education and Experience

1. A master’s or bachelor’s degree in food science/food technology or equivalent qualification.
2. Should have handled 3P operations
3. Knowledge of lab technique of analyzing different food product.
4. Good in MS word, excel, and power point.
5. Good organoleptic senses for product and sensory evaluation.
6. Lead Auditor (Any GFSI Scheme Certified PCQI Personnel Preferred.

**Preferred Knowledge**

1. Knowledge of lab technique and prior training in fundamental quality assurance technology.
2. Basic Knowledge of Quality Assurance; GFSI and Regulatory (US FDA); FSMA and other Regulatory standards.
3. Good Technical skills.
4. Good communication skills.
5. Aptitude in problem-solving.
6. Working with start-up environment

Competencies

1. Teamwork.
2. Communication.
3. Consultation.
4. Ethical Practice
5. Problem Solving

jobs.description:
**Location: Northeast**

**Territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI**

If you are interested in the below position, please send your resume to careers@tgtxinc.com and REFERENCE THE POSITION TITLE within the subject line.

Organizational Overview

TG Therapeutics is a fully integrated, commercial stage, biotechnology company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell diseases. In addition to a research pipeline including several investigational medicines, TG Therapeutics has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for BRIUMVI® (ublituximab-xiiy) for the treatment of adult patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, as well as approval by several foreign nations for BRIUMVI to treat adult patients with RMS who have active disease defined by clinical or imaging features. For more information, visit www.TGTherapeutics.com.

Role

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based regional Medical Affairs professional responsible for developing and enhancing relationships with medical professionals, researchers, clinical trial support staff, advocacy, and other members of the Myasthenia Gravis (MG) scientific and clinical community. Additionally, the MSL will demonstrate scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise during scientific engagements with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs) and requires credibility to engage top national and regional thought leaders.

Reporting into the MSL Team Field Director, the MSL is a critical role in TG Therapeutics’ customer-facing field model, collaborating compliantly with cross-functional teams including Clinical Development, Sales, Marketing, and Market Access to provide clinical support and education.

This role will cover the following territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI

Key Responsibilities

* Be a credible medical/scientific expert
* Fair-balanced scientific engagement across the assigned geography; establishes and maintains relationships with KOLs, HCPs, clinics and institutions, payers, and other stakeholders within the MG area
* Responsive and engages regularly with thought leaders and external stakeholders
* Collaborate and support Clinical Development and Clinical Operations research initiatives including site identification and trial recruitment
* Partner with clinical trial sites to optimize patient recruitment strategies, leveraging both data-driven insights and relationship-building
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and Medical Affairs—to troubleshoot recruitment challenges and streamline processes
* Monitor site performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve enrollment rates.
* Support investigator meetings, site initiation visits, and ongoing trial communications
* Maintain compliance with all regulatory requirements and company SOPs while fostering trust and transparency with stakeholders
* Supports Medical Affairs initiatives (advisory board meetings) and informs medical strategy through capturing and reporting of medical insights
* Keeps current on disease state, therapeutic landscape, and competitor data and records insights
* Utilize effective, confident, and professional communications to establish strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Respond to and documents unsolicited medical requests (MIRs) for information in a timely manner
* Support Market Access by educating payers (Health plans and state Medicaids) and key decision makers (Pharmacists and P&T Committees) on the clinical efficacy and safety profile to support formulary decisions
* Liaise unsolicited submissions and information for investigator-initiated trials (IITs) between the investigator and home office Medical Affairs
* Lead and/or participate in special projects or initiatives aligned to US Medical strategy and objectives
* Maintain accurate reporting and documentation of MSL activities

Professional Experience/Qualifications

* A scientific or clinical professional with a passion for science and deep scientific knowledge
* At least 2 years of experience in a Medical Science Liaison or similar role (MG disease experience preferred); will consider candidates with > 5 years of MG clinical experience
* Must have well-established networks and active relationships with KOLs in the MG community
* Strong knowledge of GCP guidelines and clinical trial processes
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex science into clear, actionable insights
* Energetically embraces responsibilities, demonstrates initiative, and excellent time management
* Agile, adaptable
* A collaborative mindset and genuine passion for improving patient outcomes
* Field-based, with the ability to travel approximately 75%

Education

* Advanced Scientific or Clinical degree (MD, PharmD, PhD, DNP) with a minimum of 2 years of relevant clinical or pharmaceutical experience; NP or PA with 5 or more years clinical experience in MG will be considered. Must reside in the territory.

Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Poultry Nutrition Specialist should have technical expertise and science-driven insights to design, evaluate, and optimize poultry feed formulations. In this role, you will support raw material selection, feed program design, and diet modifications to improve bird performance, health, feed efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also provide analytical and advisory services to R&D, production, and commercial teams on key poultry nutritional considerations. You should be able to learn and adopt Cargill’s nutrition system and apply it in your feed formulations for precise nutrition.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Provide technical support and feed formulations to poultry producers and feed mills for precise nutrition, feeding programs (broilers, layers, breeders), and performance optimization.
* Formulate and optimize poultry feed formulation based on raw material quality, nutrient specifications, cost targets, and production goals.
* Monitor and evaluate feed quality, ingredient variability, and nutritional consistency to ensure feed meet required nutrient specifications and bird performance standards.
* Analyse performance data (FCR, body weight gain, egg production, mortality, etc.) and recommend nutritional interventions to address production challenges.
* Maintain and update nutritional databases (ingredients, feed formulations, nutrient matrices) using laboratory data and industry benchmarks.
* Collaborate with Cargill’s Global Nutrition experts and commercial teams to incorporate market trends, ingredient availability, and cost optimization strategies.
* Conduct trials at Cargill’s Technology Application Centre and support field trials to validate feed formulations, additives, and nutritional strategies and create scientific trial reports.
* Independently solve moderately complex nutritional and production issues, escalating more complex concerns to global experts when required.
* Deliver technical presentations, training sessions, and documentation to internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* M.V.Sc (Animal Nutrition).
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in poultry nutrition, feed formulation and poultry industry.
* Demonstrated knowledge of poultry nutritional requirements (broilers, layers, breeders) and feed ingredient evaluation.
* Experience with feed formulation software and nutritional modelling.
* Other minimum qualifications may apply.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Animal Nutrition.
* Experience in commercial poultry operations or feed industry.
* Knowledge of alternative ingredients, feed additives, and enzyme technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.

jobs.title: SPE-Claims HC
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
This role focuses on delivering high quality support and analysis for healthcare products within commercial claims operations in a day shift office environment. The specialist will apply domain expertise to interpret claims resolve issues and improve processing efficiency while ensuring compliance with company standards and regulatory expectations. Contributions will strengthen organizational performance and promote better outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze commercial healthcare claims data in detail to ensure accurate adjudication and compliance with internal policies and industry regulations driving reliable claim outcomes and operational integrity.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams to clarify claim requirements product rules and benefit structures helping to minimize processing errors and improve end user satisfaction.
* Review complex healthcare product configurations related to commercial claims identifying gaps or inconsistencies and recommending adjustments that enhance claim accuracy and turnaround times.
* Coordinate with operations and quality teams to investigate claim discrepancies document root causes and support remediation activities that reduce rework and improve service levels.
* Utilize claim processing tools and internal platforms to validate eligibility coverage and pricing logic for healthcare products contributing to transparent and fair claim decisions.
* Support process improvement initiatives by tracking key metrics for commercial claims proposing practical changes that improve efficiency reduce manual effort and support sustainable growth.
* Communicate clearly with internal stakeholders using English read write and speak capabilities to explain claim outcomes product rules and process changes in an accessible and professional manner.
* Maintain thorough documentation of claim analysis activities decisions and exceptions ensuring that records support audit readiness and consistent application of healthcare product guidelines.
* Engage in knowledge sharing sessions with peers to exchange insights on commercial claims scenarios emerging product features and best practices that strengthen team capability.
* Monitor day to day claim queues in the office environment prioritize work based on service commitments and ensure timely resolution of cases without requiring travel.
* Apply sound judgment to escalate complex claim issues involving healthcare products enabling quick resolution by specialized teams and protecting member and client interests.
* Support compliance with organizational standards by following established procedures validating data integrity and raising risks or anomalies that could impact claim reliability or regulatory adherence.
* Contribute to broader organizational and societal impact by helping ensure that commercial healthcare claims are processed accurately supporting fair access to healthcare services and reinforcing trust in the healthcare system.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate solid experience in healthcare products with practical exposure to product rules benefit structures and claim processing flows within commercial environments.
* Possess mandatory domain experience in commercial claims with hands on involvement in evaluating claim eligibility coverage determination and payment decisions.
* Bring between two and four years of professional experience in healthcare claims or related operations showing consistent performance and growing subject matter expertise.
* Use strong English read write and speak skills to articulate complex claim and product information clearly to colleagues and stakeholders across business functions.
* Show proficiency in using claim processing platforms and basic analytical tools to interpret data identify patterns and support continuous improvement of claims workflows.
* Exhibit attention to detail and structured thinking while reviewing claims enabling accurate decisions that support company objectives and positive outcomes for members and providers.

**Certifications Required**
Certified Professional Coder CPC or equivalent healthcare claims certification preferred but not mandatory.

jobs.title: Fraud Senior Analyst –Payment Integrity Provider Investigation
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**
The Fraud Senior Analyst plays a critical role in protecting the organization’s International Health portfolio by leading Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA) investigations, driving measurable affordability outcomes, and strengthening prevention strategies across the claims lifecycle. The position combines investigative expertise, data-driven insight, and stakeholder influence to reduce financial leakage, improve claim governance and support sustainable savings delivery across the region. This role is responsible for detecting and recovering FWA payments, creating solutions to prevent claims overpayment and future spend monitoring within a dedicated region. He / She will work closely with other PI team members, Network, Medical Economics, Data Analytics, Claims Operations, Clinical partners, and Product.
  
  
**Job Profile**
Operating with a high degree of independence, the Fraud Senior Analyst owns end-to-end investigative activities within a dedicated region. The role extends beyond case handling to include proactive identification of systemic risks, development of preventive controls, and partnership with regional and global stakeholders to enhance Payment Integrity strategy. The incumbent acts as a subject matter expert, contributing to operational improvements, automation initiatives, and cross-market collaboration to strengthen FWA detection and mitigation capabilities.
  
  
**Reports to:**
Fraud Manager
  
  
**Critical Tasks And Expected Contributions / Results**

* Lead FWA investigations across International Markets, applying investigative judgement to identify billing anomalies, emerging fraud typologies, and systemic risk patterns.
* Deliver quantifiable financial impact through cost containment, recoveries, and forward-looking prevention initiatives aligned to regional savings objectives.
* Translate data insights into actionable investigation strategies by partnering closely with Data and Analytics teams to refine triggers, reporting frameworks and automation opportunities.
* Influence provider behavior through structured Provider audit engagement, negotiation, and collaboration with regional and global stakeholders to reduce future risk exposure.
* Drive continuous improvement of Payment Integrity processes by identifying operational gaps and proposing scalable solutions that enhance efficiency and accuracy.
* Produce clear, defensible investigative findings and recommendations for senior stakeholders, ensuring transparency and audit readiness.
* Ensure investigations and cost containment actions are balanced with fair member outcomes, regulatory expectations, and client commitments.
* Collaborate with Customer Service and Client Management teams to support clear, consistent communication approaches that protect member experience while maintaining investigative integrity
* Operate within established governance frameworks, ensuring investigative activities are compliant with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.
* Collaborate with the Member Investigation Unit on Fraud cases when required.
* Perform periodic TPA oversight and partner with TPAs on FWA investigations when required.
* Partner with Data Analytics team in building future FWA triggers automation.
* Mentor and provide support through knowledge sharing, quality review input and guidance on investigative best practices and share FWA claiming schemes.
* Ad hoc duties as assigned

**Key Challenges / Anticipated Changes In Environment**

* Rapid evolution of provider billing models and fraud schemes requiring adaptive investigative approaches.
* Increasing claim volumes and evolving FWA typologies requiring advanced analytical and investigative skills
* Balancing operational turnaround times with deep investigative rigor, stakeholder expectations and member experience considerations
* Expanding use of automation, data analytics, and cross-market collaboration within Payment Integrity operations
* Managing complex provider relationships while maintaining firm compliance and cost containment positions
* Navigating diverse regulatory and healthcare environments across multiple international markets

**Developmental Value Of Position**

* Strengthens strategic thinking through ownership of regional investigative portfolios and measurable savings delivery.
* Builds advanced expertise in international health insurance investigations, audit frameworks, and provider engagement strategies
* Develops leadership capabilities through ownership of complex cases, cross-functional collaboration, and influence without direct people management
* Provides exposure to advanced analytics initiatives, provider strategy discussions and global Payment Integrity frameworks
* Opportunity to deepen technical knowledge in healthcare claims coding, regulatory consideration and fraud risk management

**Experience/Knowledge, Education And Other Requirements**

* You should enjoy working in a team of high performers, who hold each other accountable to perform to their very best.
* Experience of investigation within payment integrity or similar discipline.
* Minimum of 4 years of health insurance or health care provider experience.
* Knowledge of Mainframe, GlobalCare, Actisure and / or Diamond essential.
* Knowledge of claims coding, regulatory rules and medical policy.
* Medical/ paramedical qualification is a definite plus.
* Critical mind-set with ability to identify cost containment opportunities.
* Experience with data analytics
* Demonstrated strong organization skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to quickly learn new and complex tasks and concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to balance multiple priorities at once and deliver on tight timelines.
* Flexibility to work with global teams and varying time zones effectively.
* Experience in liaising with internal stakeholders and ability to work independently within a cross functional team.
* Strong organization skills with the ability to juggle priorities and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines.
* Fluency in foreign languages in addition to fluent English is a strong plus.

**About The Cigna Group**
Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

**About the Role**

ZS seeks a Content Platform & Services Manager to join our team in Bengaluru, India. * **Modular content.** Experience with content reuse and modular content strategies enabled by AI.
* **Stakeholder leadership.** Ability to coordinate effectively across Marketing, Medical, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Technology, Data, and agency partners.
* **Operational discipline.** Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage concurrent review cycles and deadlines.
* **Communication.** Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* **Education.** Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, marketing, communications, or a related field; MBA preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* **Industry background.** Prior experience at a pharmaceutical company or healthcare-focused marketing or content services organization.
* **Content governance.** Familiarity with taxonomy, metadata standards, and digital asset management best practices.
* **Process improvement.** Experience driving automation or continuous improvement within content operations.
* **Reporting tools.** Exposure to Power BI or Tableau for operational reporting and dashboards.
* **GenAI tools.** Hands-on exposure to GenAI/LLM tools, prompt design, or low-code automation applied to content or compliance workflows.
